title: Two Little Worlds

shots.image: the pair of tiny baby shoes beside the crib in morning light, close view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then came two little worlds of their own: my daughter and my son.

shots.image: {MOTHER} cradling a newborn baby in a cosy sunlit room, a toddler girl in pink beside her, side view
shots.sfx: baby cooing, soft room tone, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They changed the meaning of my life.

shots.image: {MOTHER} feeding two toddlers at a small table, food on their cheeks, laughter, side view
shots.motion: the children giggle and reach for the spoon
shots.sfx: children laughing, spoons on plates, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Their little hands, their endless questions, their laughter and their everyday adventures became my greatest happiness.

shots.image: {DAUGHTER} at a small desk with a colouring book looking up, seen from the side
{SON} running into the room holding up a paper boat craft
shots.sfx: running footsteps, paper rustle, no music

shots.image: {MOTHER} kneeling between {DAUGHTER} and {SON}, laughing, seen from the side
shots.motion: she opens her arms to both

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: One at a time! Let me see both.

shots.image: {DAUGHTER} and {SON} hugging {MOTHER} together in the living room, seen from behind

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I watched them grow, helped them learn and celebrated their smallest achievements.

shots.image: busy school morning: {MOTHER} packing two school bags and tiffins as {DAUGHTER} and {SON} wait at the door
shots.motion: she zips the bags and hands them over
shots.sfx: zips, footsteps, morning birds, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was their mother, their guide and their biggest cheerleader.

shots.image: {MOTHER} reading a bedtime story to {DAUGHTER} and {SON} tucked in bed, warm lamp glow, side view
shots.motion: she turns a page, the children's eyes close
shots.sfx: page turning, quiet night, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And while I was helping them discover the world,

shots.image: {MOTHER} looking at an old classroom photograph and her teaching notebook while {DAUGHTER} and {SON} play on the floor nearby, seen over her shoulder
shots.sfx: children playing softly, toy blocks, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was quietly preparing to rediscover mine.
